description: This file defines a PHP class 'CurrentLanguage' within the 'SuiteCRM\Utility' namespace. The class provides a method to retrieve the current language setting, utilizing a global variable.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Utility\CurrentLanguage
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to get the current language used in the application.

methods.name: getCurrentLanguage
methods.description: Returns the value of the global variable '$current_language' representing the current language.
